name: robb-agents
description: Robb Agents — local-first desktop workspace for autonomous AI agents

scripts.typecheck:all: node scripts/run-typescript.mjs native --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-typescript.mjs native --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-typescript.mjs native --noEmit -p packages/server-core/tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-typescript.mjs native --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-typescript.mjs native --noEmit -p packages/session-tools-core/tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-typescript.mjs native --noEmit -p packages/session-mcp-server/tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-typescript.mjs native --noEmit -p packages/messaging-gateway/tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-typescript.mjs native --noEmit -p packages/messaging-whatsapp-worker/tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-typescript.mjs native --noEmit -p packages/pi-agent-server/tsconfig.typecheck.json && node scripts/run-typescript.mjs native --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-typescript.mjs native --noEmit -p apps/cli/tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-typescript.mjs native --noEmit -p apps/electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-typescript.mjs native --noEmit -p apps/viewer/tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-typescript.mjs native --noEmit -p apps/viewer/tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/run-typescript.mjs native --noEmit -p apps/webui/tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-typescript.mjs native --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.server:dev: bun run server:build:subprocess && CRAFT_DEBUG=true CRAFT_BUNDLED_ASSETS_ROOT=$PWD/apps/electron bun run packages/server/src/index.ts
scripts.test:shared:playbooks: cd packages/shared && bun test src/playbooks/validation.test.ts src/playbooks/storage.test.ts src/playbooks/builtins.test.ts
scripts.test:shared:all: bun run test:shared:llm-connections && bun run test:shared:models-pi && bun run test:shared:config && bun run test:shared:autonomy && bun run test:shared:playbooks && bun run test:shared:automations
scripts.test:agent-recovery: cd packages/server-core && bun test src/sessions/refresh-connection-runtime.test.ts && bun test src/sessions/session-runtime-eviction.test.ts src/sessions/background-task-surface.test.ts src/sessions/turn-completion.test.ts src/sessions/turn-recovery.test.ts src/sessions/runtime-interruption-recovery.test.ts && cd ../pi-agent-server && bun test src/overflow-recovery.test.ts src/incomplete-tool-tail-recovery.test.ts && cd ../shared && bun test src/agent/__tests__/pi-event-adapter.test.ts src/agent/__tests__/pi-agent-process-recovery.test.ts src/agent/__tests__/claude-process-recovery.test.ts
scripts.validate:dev: bun run validate:versions && bun run typecheck:all && bun run typecheck:release-contract && bun run test:shared:all && bun run test:agent-recovery && bun run test:package-audit && bun run test:doc-tools && bun run test:release-contract && bun run test:installer-contract
scripts.validate:ci: bun run validate:dev && bun run lint:i18n:parity && bun run lint:i18n:sorted && bun run lint:i18n:coverage
scripts.lint: bun run lint:ipc-sends && bun run lint:tool-name-checks && bun run lint:electron && bun run lint:shared && bun run lint:server-core && bun run lint:ui
scripts.electron:build: bun run webui:build && bun run electron:build:main && bun run electron:build:preload && bun run electron:build:renderer && bun run electron:build:resources && bun run electron:build:assets
scripts.electron:dev: bun run rtk:prepare && bun run scripts/electron-dev.ts
scripts.electron:dev:playwright: bun run webui:build && CRAFT_CONFIG_DIR=/tmp/robb-agents-playwright bun run scripts/prepare-robb-playwright-profile.ts && CRAFT_VITE_PORT=6173 CRAFT_INSTANCE_NUMBER=e2e CRAFT_APP_NAME='Robb Agents Dev E2E' CRAFT_CONFIG_DIR=/tmp/robb-agents-playwright CRAFT_DEEPLINK_SCHEME=robbagentsdeve2e CRAFT_ELECTRON_REMOTE_DEBUGGING_PORT=9333 bun run electron:dev
scripts.electron:dev:logs: pgrep -f 'tail -f.*@craft-agent/electron/main.log' > /dev/null || osascript -e "tell application \"Terminal\" to do script \"$PWD/scripts/tail-electron-logs.sh\""
scripts.electron:dist: bun run rtk:prepare && bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:dist:mac: bun run rtk:prepare && bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac
scripts.electron:dist:win: bun run rtk:prepare && bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win
scripts.electron:dist:linux: bun run rtk:prepare && bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux
scripts.electron:dist:dev:mac: bun run rtk:prepare && CRAFT_DEV_RUNTIME=1 ROBB_BUILD_CHANNEL=development bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.dev.yml --mac
scripts.electron:dist:dev:win: bun run rtk:prepare && CRAFT_DEV_RUNTIME=1 ROBB_BUILD_CHANNEL=development bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.dev.yml --win
scripts.electron:dist:dev:linux: bun run rtk:prepare && CRAFT_DEV_RUNTIME=1 ROBB_BUILD_CHANNEL=development bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.dev.yml --linux
scripts.playground:dev: lsof -ti:5173 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; vite dev --config apps/electron/vite.config.ts --open /playground.html
scripts.viewer:dev: lsof -ti:5174 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; vite dev --config apps/viewer/vite.config.ts --open /s/tz5-13I84pwK_he
scripts.webui:dev: lsof -ti:5175 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; vite dev --config apps/webui/vite.config.ts
scripts.server:build:subprocess: cd packages/session-mcp-server && bun run build && cd ../pi-agent-server && bun run build
scripts.server:prod: bun run server:build:subprocess && bun run webui:build && CRAFT_WEBUI_DIR=apps/webui/dist CRAFT_BUNDLED_ASSETS_ROOT=$PWD/apps/electron bun run packages/server/src/index.ts
scripts.server:dev:webui: bun run server:build:subprocess && bun run webui:build && CRAFT_WEBUI_DIR=apps/webui/dist CRAFT_WEBUI_PORT=3100 bun run server:dev
scripts.docs:dev: cd apps/online-docs && npm install && npx mintlify dev
